love.label: Love / Relationships
positive: Yes. This is going to work out.
Someone is thinking about you more than they let on.
It could turn into something more, if you let it.
ambiguous: Their feelings haven't settled yet. It could go either way.
It might happen, just not on the timeline you want.
An old feeling is coming back. Whether that's good news is hard to say.
negative: No. This one isn't meant to work out.
This may already be ending, even if it doesn't feel like it yet.
They may come back, but not as what you want them to be.

career.label: Career / Success
positive: Good news about work or money is on its way.
It will pay off, but later than you'd like.
ambiguous: Things will start moving once you take the first step.
Someone has noticed your work. It's too early to say what they think.
You're close, but it isn't finished yet.
negative: Expect a delay before anything changes.
It won't go as planned, but something else may come out of it.

decision.label: Decisions / Choices
positive: The choice you're leaning toward is the right one.
It will work out, as long as you don't wait too long.
ambiguous: Both options will cost you something.
The answer will be clearer in a few days.
Someone else's decision may end up making this one for you.
negative: Something you don't know yet would change your mind.

general.label: General / Future
positive: Good things are ahead, though not all at once.
ambiguous: Part of this isn't up to you.
It could happen, but not in the way you expect.
Change is coming. Whether you'll welcome it is another question.
negative: This may not turn out the way you pictured it.
It gets harder before it gets better.

reflection.yes: Sometimes, the answer we hope for is the one we are most ready to believe.
reflection.no: What did you hope the answer would say?
reflection.unsure: Perhaps uncertainty is part of what brought you here.
